title: Business Risk Team Lead - Community Markets
description: Overview: Implement defined first line of defense risk management initiatives within the business unit in support of the Enterprise Risk Framework. Manage the risk work and coordinate with individuals responsible for risk and control functions in the business unit. Serve as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for execution of risk functions; Serve as project leader on complex and highly visible risk management projects. Primary Responsibilities: Responsible for the execution of risk initiatives that this position leads or for which their team is responsible to conduct. Responsible for completely and accurately documenting key business processes. Identify and assess risks and internal controls associated with the key processes under your leadership. Actively participate in the planning, execution and reporting of the business unit's risk-based testing program. Perform control testing as an individual contributor and ensure control testing is performed for the team's risk initiatives in accordance with M&T's First Line of Defense Guidance on Management of Risks & Internal Controls and professional standards. Specific control testing responsibilities will involve the review of testing , and evaluating results to determine if issues exist. Responsibilities may also include independent performance of scripted testing as well as system administrative duties such as the maintenance, validation, and / or updating in the compliance data management system (Archer). Communicate findings to management. Monitor business unit performance with respect to established key risk indicators (KRIs), and recommend enhancements to strengthen risk control structure. Accurately complete Risk Control Self Assessments (RCSAs) and other risk management reporting, recommending enhancements to each. Assist in the reporting and escalation of risk events and loss events. Identify emerging risks and risks associated with new products/ services/ markets/ channels or changes to existing products/ services/ markets/ channels, as well as the control structures needed to mitigate the risks. Provide guidance on the development of remediation plans. Manage the timely completion of remediation plans and other projects to address issues identified internally and by Enterprise Risk Management, Compliance, Internal Audit or external regulators. Validate the quality of the plans implemented. Implement and oversee the adherence to policies and procedures for the business unit. This includes identifying updates or enhancements as business unit processes change. In addition, assist in responding to both internal and external requests in relation to departmental processes and procedures. Adhere to applicable compliance/operational risk controls in accordance with Company or regulatory standards and policies. Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand. Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable. Complete other related duties as assigned. Education and Experience Required: Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 5 years' relevant work experience, or in lieu of a degree, a combined minimum of 9 years' higher education and/or work experience, including a minimum of 5 years' relevant work experience Education and Experience Required: Minimum of 2 years’ experience working in risk identification, risk mitigation, risk and control self-assessment, or related disciplines Experience in understanding [Corporate Services (Third Party Risk Management, Corporate Real Estate, and the like) / Community Markets (CRA, Foundation, Sustainability)] and the Compliance and Operational risks associated therein is helpful M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $89,600.00 - $149,300.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation. Location Buffalo, New York, United States of America

title: Head Of National Security Policy
description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. About the Role Veeam is seeking a Head of National Security Policy to serve as the senior-most technical authority for Veeam's full portfolio of government-facing products. This leader will define the technical strategy for how Veeam's data resilience and data security platforms — including Securiti AI's federal offering — are architected, deployed, and certified within U.S. government environments. The role carries a heavy near-term focus on Securiti AI Federal, where this person will work with engineering to drive the technical roadmap, integration architecture, and compliance posture required for the platform to operate inside classified and controlled federal networks. This is a hybrid role: equal parts deep technical credibility with government network architectures and AI system deployment, and direct engagement with the engineering teams building for this market. The Head of National Security Policy reports directly to Veeam's corporate CTO and works in daily collaboration with Veeam's government strategy, sales, and solutions engineering leadership to align product direction with mission needs. What You Will Do Government Network & Compliance Strategy Serve as Veeam's principal technical authority on U.S. government network architectures, including DoD, IC, and civilian agency environments, air-gapped and classified networks, and cross-domain solutions. Work with engineering on the technical strategy and execution for FedRAMP High, DoD IL5, and IL6 authorization across Veeam's public sector product lines, partnering with compliance, security, and ATO stakeholders to reach and sustain accreditation. Translate evolving federal compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, DoD SRG, NIST 800-53, CMMC, StateRAMP) into concrete architecture and engineering requirements. Represent Veeam in agency technical reviews, security assessments, and authorizing official (AO) engagements as the senior technical sponsor. AI Deployment & Integration, with a Focus on Securiti AI Federal Drive the technical strategy for deploying AI and data-security capabilities — including Securiti AI's federal product line — inside government network boundaries, covering model hosting, data classification, data residency, and secure integration patterns. Help define the architecture for how Securiti AI Federal integrates with Veeam's broader data resilience portfolio and with agency-owned infrastructure, identity systems, and data platforms. Guide decisions on where and how AI workloads can run within federal boundaries (on-prem, air-gapped, GovCloud, IL5/IL6 environments) and the security controls required at each layer. Stay ahead of federal AI governance requirements (e.g., agency AI use policies, model risk management, data provenance) and ensure Veeam's roadmap anticipates them rather than reacts to them. Engineering & Team Leadership Support efforts to build, lead, and grow a dedicated public sector development organization, guiding technical direction, engineering standards, and delivery cadence. Recruit and mentor engineering managers and senior engineers with backgrounds in federal/government systems, secure software development, and AI infrastructure. Establish secure SDLC practices appropriate for FedRAMP and DoD authorization boundaries, including change management, continuous monitoring, and POA&M remediation workflows. Partner with Veeam's corporate engineering and product organizations to ensure public sector requirements are reflected in the core product roadmap rather than maintained as permanent forks. Cross-Functional & Executive Collaboration Act as the primary technical counterpart to Veeam's government strategy and go-to-market leadership, translating agency and partner requirements into product and engineering commitments. Collaborate closely with Veeam's corporate CTO organization to align public sector architecture with overall platform strategy, security posture, and roadmap. Support sales, solutions engineering, and channel/OEM partners in technical discussions with agency customers, integrators, and FedRAMP third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs). Present technical strategy and program status to Veeam executive leadership and, as needed, to agency and partner stakeholders. You will coach, mentor, and guide the team in the application of data mining and data analysis methods, be adept with common large data processing techniques, computational programing capabilities, practical problem-solving skills, and have an ability to articulate solutions to non-technical consumers or partners. As a lead associate, you will partner and coordinate with data engineering and data management teams, and provide guidance to your team in the application of data mining techniques to external or created data sources in preparation for analysis or use of enterprise data assets.
